summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K (foreign-private-issuer current report) disclosing the status of its ongoing share repurchase, a routine capital-return progress update rather than a new structural event. Under the May 11, 2026 board authorization for up to 100 million shares (about 9.1% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) and up to JPY 250 billion through March 31, 2027, ORIX bought 6,291,100 common shares for JPY 36,504,385,500 in October 2026, taking cumulative repurchases to 28,364,900 shares for JPY 175,483,966,900 (roughly 70% of the monetary cap). Market purchases via a discretionary dealing contract; watch remaining authorization pace and buyback-price support versus earnings delivery.
